description: This file defines a transform function for processing spatial scatter plot data in a Superset visualization plugin, including data processing utilities and exporting a main transformProps function.

classes.name: ScatterPoint
classes.description: Interface representing a scatter plot point with position, optional radius, color, category color, metric, and extra properties.

methods.name: processScatterData
methods.description: Processes raw data records into scatter point features, assigning position, radius, color, and additional properties based on spatial data and form configuration.

methods.name: transformProps
methods.description: Main exported function that transforms chart properties into spatial scatter plot features for rendering.
